mapper.update: update dish_templates set category_id=#{template.categoryId},name=#{template.name},description=#{template.description}, image_url=#{template.imageUrl},image_source_url=#{template.imageSourceUrl},image_author=#{template.imageAuthor}, image_license=#{template.imageLicense},reference_price=#{template.referencePrice},taste_tags=#{template.tasteTags}, meal_tags=#{template.mealTags},sort_order=#{template.sortOrder},enabled=#{template.enabled},version=version+1 where id=#{template.id} and version=#{baseVersion}

update dish_templates set category_id=#{template.categoryId},name=#{template.name}, description=#{template.description},reference_price=#{template.referencePrice}, taste_tags=#{template.tasteTags},meal_tags=#{template.mealTags},enabled=#{template.enabled}, data_status=#{template.dataStatus},procurement_ready=#{template.procurementReady},version=version+1 where id=#{template.id} and version=#{expectedVersion}

update dish_template_image_assets set asset_status='PUBLISHED',public_image_url=#{publicImageUrl}, image_author=#{author},image_license=#{license},reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at=current_timestamp,rejection_reason=null where id=#{assetId} and asset_status='INTERNAL_REVIEW'
